title: VSTEP Test 6 - C1
description: Bài thi thử VSTEP trình độ C1. Bài thi gồm 4 phần: Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking.

sections.name: Listening
sections.instructions: Nghe và trả lời các câu hỏi. Bạn sẽ được nghe mỗi đoạn 2 lần.

sections.name: Reading
sections.instructions: Đọc các đoạn văn và trả lời câu hỏi trắc nghiệm.

sections.name: Writing
sections.instructions: Hoàn thành 2 bài viết theo yêu cầu đề bài.

questions.questionText: Task 1 (Test 6): Write an email of about 120 words to a friend describing a recent event you attended.
questions.explanation: Your email should include: greeting, description of the event, your feelings, closing.

questions.questionText: Task 2 (Test 6): Write an essay of about 250 words discussing the advantages and disadvantages of studying abroad.

sections.name: Speaking
sections.instructions: Trả lời các câu hỏi nói theo hướng dẫn.

questions.questionText: Part 1 (Test 6): Introduce yourself. Talk about your name, where you live, your job/studies, and your hobbies.
Part 2 (Test 6): Look at the picture and describe what you see. Then answer the follow-up questions.
Part 3 (Test 6): Discuss the topic: 'How has technology changed education?' Present your views and provide examples.
